title: Add structured armor AC data for deterministic equipment calculations
description:
The SRD 5.1 equipment records preserve armor AC values as source-shaped strings, which is accurate enough for prose/display but weaker than needed for deterministic character-sheet and combat tooling.

Confirmed in the 2026-06-30 audit bundle `/home/jhbongaarts/src/dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle-0630-1.zip`:
- `equipment:chain-mail` has `data.ac: "16"`.
- `equipment:leather` has `data.ac: "11 + Dex modifier"`.
- `equipment:shield` has `data.ac: "+2"`.
- No structured fields distinguish base AC, Dex modifier allowance/cap, shield bonus, stealth disadvantage, or strength requirements as machine-executable armor rules.

This is not a current pack accuracy blocker: the string values match the source-shaped table data and existing schema/tests permit them. It is a deterministic gameplay usability gap for tools that need to compute AC without reparsing prose/formula strings.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide and document the structured armor/equipment AC schema needed by deterministic tools.
- Emit structured armor calculation data for SRD armor and shields while retaining source text/provenance.
- Add validation/tests for representative light armor, medium armor, heavy armor, and shield records.
close_reason: Added structured data.armorClass ({base, dexModifier, dexModifierCap?} for armor; {bonus} for shields) derived deterministically from the verbatim ac cell, alongside the retained ac string. Validated in kindSchemas.ts; fails closed on any AC shape outside the four reviewed SRD 5.1 cases.
